mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate relative to historical averages compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tight labor market, increasing corporate profit margins through higher labor productivity and wage growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in household spending, which triggers a sell-off in the S&P 500 as investors anticipate reduced corporate revenues, resulting in negative forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The negative correlation between the joint decline of HOUST and RSAFS and SPX 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100), supply chain disruptions intensify, leading to higher inflation and reduced corporate profitability, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer credit balance (RSAFS) indicates increased household leverage and spending, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The positive correlation between RSAFS and SPX 20-day returns is not significant (Rank IC < 0.03) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% annually signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a severe economic contraction, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint movement of INDPRO and UNRATE does not predict SPX 60-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) in a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong labor market conditions (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly), wage growth accelerates, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 0.5%.
